Position: Construction Project Manager
Position Type: Full Time
Salary: $110,000 - $130,000 p.a plus Super
Employer Name: J & DE HOMES PTY LTD - T/a JDE HOMES
A.B.N. 24 614 743 789
Job Location: Level 2, 207 Pulteney Street, Adelaide, SA, 5000,  AUSTRALIA
Advertising Period: 28 days - 13 Jul 2026 > 10 Aug 2026

Please include Reference: J1697-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Summary

Our client JDE Homes is seeking to add a Construction Project Manager to its South Australian construction and development team. The company delivers fixed-price property construction, development and project management services across residential, civil, industrial and commercial projects. This role will support the planning, coordination and delivery of technically challenging building projects, while maintaining quality, budget, safety and completion requirements.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

- Plan, organise and manage construction projects from commencement through to practical completion.
- Coordinate project resources, including labour, subcontractors, materials, plant and equipment.
- Interpret architectural drawings, construction plans, engineering details and technical specifications.
- Monitor project budgets, timelines, quality standards, risks and contractual obligations.
- Liaise with architects, engineers, consultants, clients, subcontractors and relevant authorities.
- Manage procurement scheduling and ensure materials are available to meet construction milestones.
- Supervise site progress and ensure works align with approved plans and specifications.
- Coordinate inspections, approvals and documentation required by councils and regulatory bodies.
- Ensure adherence to workplace health, safety, building and performance standards.
- Negotiate with suppliers, subcontractors and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
- Prepare project reports, progress updates, cost reviews and construction documentation.
- Manage project variations, delays, defects and implementation of corrective actions.
- Lead subcontractors and site teams to achieve quality and programme outcomes.
- Support tender preparation, contract administration and construction methodology recommendations.
- Maintain professional communication with clients to support cost-effective project delivery.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:

- Minimum ten years of relevant experience in construction project management or building project delivery.
- Strong ability to manage residential, commercial, civil or industrial construction projects from start to finish.
- Demonstrated experience coordinating subcontractors, trades, consultants, suppliers, plant, equipment and site resources.
- Sound knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, building processes, safety obligations and quality standards.
- Proven ability to monitor project costs, budgets, schedules, risks, variations and completion deadlines.
- Strong communication skills for liaising with clients, architects, engineers, authorities and internal project teams.
- Practical experience resolving construction issues and recommending cost-effective building methods or project solutions.
- Ability to work without direct supervision while maintaining accurate project records and professional standards.

Please include Reference: J1697-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Due to the volume of applicants, only those meeting the minimum standards will be considered and only successful applicants will be contacted.  Thank you for your interest in the role.

Salary: $80,000 plus 12% superannuation

Our client, Go Logistics Pty Ltd, is a respected leader in the transport and logistics industry, providing time-critical freight solutions throughout New South Wales and Canberra. The company specialises in the safe and reliable delivery of medical supplies, industrial equipment and other urgent freight, offering a comprehensive range of logistics services including same-day delivery, break bulk distribution, cross-docking, warehousing and distribution.

To support its continued growth and expanding operations, Go Logistics Pty Ltd is seeking a highly organised and experienced Office Manager to oversee the company's administrative operations and ensure the efficient coordination of office systems that support transport, fleet and customer service activities.

Working closely with senior management, dispatch staff, drivers and customers, the successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining efficient office operations, supporting compliance requirements, coordinating administrative processes and ensuring the smooth day-to-day functioning of the business.

Key Responsibilities

-	Manage the day-to-day administrative operations of the office to support transport and logistics activities. 
-	Develop, implement and review office policies, administrative procedures and record management systems to improve operational efficiency. 
-	Coordinate office resources, equipment, supplies and service providers to ensure uninterrupted business operations. 
-	Maintain and control operational documentation including customer records, transport documentation, contracts, permits and compliance records. 
-	Coordinate administrative support for dispatch, fleet operations and customer service teams. 
-	Liaise with customers, suppliers, contractors and service providers regarding administrative and operational requirements. 
-	Assist with scheduling meetings, preparing reports, maintaining company correspondence and supporting management with operational documentation. 
-	Coordinate staff rosters, leave records, onboarding administration and other human resource support functions. 
-	Monitor office expenditure, process invoices, maintain purchasing records and assist with budget administration. 
-	Ensure office operations comply with company policies, workplace health and safety requirements and relevant regulatory obligations. 
-	Prepare operational reports, maintain databases and provide administrative support for business performance reporting. 
-	Identify opportunities to improve administrative systems, workflows and document management processes. 
-	Support senior management with general business administration and special projects as required. 
Candidate

The successful applicant will be a motivated and well-organised Office Manager with previous experience in office administration, preferably within the transport, logistics or related industries.

To be successful you will possess:

-	A Diploma or higher qualification in Business Administration, Management or a related discipline. 
-	At least one year of relevant Office Manager experience (or equivalent highly relevant administrative management experience). 
-	Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise competing tasks. 
-	Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to liaise effectively with clients, suppliers and staff. 
-	High attention to detail and excellent record management skills. 
-	Experience maintaining confidential business records and preparing management reports. 

Applications for this opportunity should be forwarded by email to: recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au 
Please note only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and your application will be treated as strictly confidential.

result.description:
For over half a century, Ostojic Group has been a cornerstone of excellence in Northern Australia's transport and construction sectors. Our family-owned enterprise delivers premium services in transport logistics, civil construction, quarry operations and ready-mix concrete supply, as well as strategically located land available for purchase.

Ostojic Group is currently seeking experienced QA ENGINEER to join our team on a full time and permanent basis. A key role in the planning, coordination, and execution of civil construction projects. The primary purpose of the role is to ensure that all engineering, design, and construction activities are delivered safely, efficiently, and in compliance with project specifications, timelines, and regulatory standards.

QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

Essential
Hold a current C Class Driver’s Licence
Possess a Nationally Recognised Construction Induction Card (White Card)
Tertiary qualification in Civil Engineering
Minimum of 10 years’ experience in civil construction, with a strong preference for experience in subdivisions and/or roadworks
Excellent communication and time management skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team
Proficient in reading and interpreting contract documentation and construction drawings
Demonstrated experience in contract administration and management of subcontractors
Proven capability in the implementation and ongoing use of Project Management Systems
Desirable
First Aid Training
Fire Warden Training

GENERAL ACCOUNTABILITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Develop, review, and contribute to project plans, construction methodologies, technical drawings, specifications, and cost estimates
Plan and oversee daily site operations to ensure alignment with project requirements, timelines, and safety standards
Coordinate procurement and manage timely delivery of materials, plant, and equipment in accordance with site and subcontractor needs
Liaise with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and regulatory bodies to facilitate smooth project delivery
Conduct site surveys, inspections, and risk assessments to identify constraints and ensure WHS and environmental compliance
Monitor project progress, track milestones, and provide regular updates to clients, management, and key stakeholders
Support cost control, budgeting processes, and identification of variations and project risks
Prepare and maintain accurate project documentation including reports, QA records, ITPs, as-built drawings, and contract documentation
Participate in project meetings, performance reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives
Assist with the planning and execution of civil works including roads, bridges, buildings, and infrastructure projects
Ensure all work meets relevant codes, standards, contract specifications, and IMS (Integrated Management System) requirements
Represent the company in a professional and respectful manner, maintaining a neat appearance and fit-for-work attitude
Care for and correctly use company equipment, vehicles, and resources, maintaining high standards of cleanliness
Take responsibility for personal safety and that of others, complying with all Ostojic Group HSEQ standards and procedures
Immediately report any hazards, incidents, or accidents, and wear required PPE appropriately
Undertake additional duties as requested by Ostojic Group Management within your capabilities
Assist the Compliance Manager with quality assurance implementation and WHS risk assessments
Participate in pre-start meetings, site inductions, inspections, audits, and emergency response drills
Attend required HSEQ training sessions and support the development of SWMS and other WHS documentation
Manage quality control and compliance with project-specific and IMS requirements
Identify and resolve engineering or construction issues to maintain project quality and timelines
Ensure completion of ITPs, corrective actions, and all required documentation for client handover
Promote effective communication and coordination across project teams to uphold safety, quality, and environmental standards
Complete all training as required associated with your position

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now.
Salary: $100,000 per annum +Super

Hatted quality food, 3 goblet wine list (gourmet traveller)

Located in one of the trendiest laneways of the Eastern Suburbs, Bay Street Wine Bar Operations Pty Ltd t/a Bibo is searching for a strong restaurant manager to join our incredibly talented and strong team on a full time basis. With our floor staff having worked for some of Sydney’s top restaurant, high the level of service and extensive knowledge are required.
Designed to have a chilled-out ambience and a relaxed feel to dining, this European venue is stocked with some of the best wines in town and a regular for locals and corporates who enjoy a fine dining experience in a casual setting. The atmosphere can be quiet and intimate during the week and then bustling, loud and fun on busy Friday nights. It really caters for everyone.
The food is bold and of a high quality with a strong French base but inspiration from Portugal. The menu showcases classic flavours and seasonal produce, letting the ingredients speak for themselves.
The position is for a full time restaurant manger and will include the following tasks:

Updated the menu with the chefs
Ordering and pricing of the beverage program with the sommelier
Take reservations, organize and run functions, events and a la carte services
Rostering, training and supervising the staff
Conferring with costumers to asses their satisfaction with meals and service
Ensuring dining facilities comply with health and safety regulation.
The ideal candidate will have:
· at least two (2) years relevant work experience as a manager
· a fine dining or hatted background
· a passion for service and customers.
· knowledge about wine from around the world (especially French and Australian), bar knowledge, and management skills.
It is a full time position.
Evening shift and Saturdays

result.description:
Key Roles & Responsibilities:

· Work with business stakeholders to determine and document project high level business requirements (BRS) and obtain sign-off
· Work with business stakeholders and SME’s to elaborate requirements and obtain sign-off
· Set acceptance criteria for delivery cards
· Perform and own the data mapping activities
· Support business process design and system analysis
· Support Tech Lead as required on data modelling activities
· Transfer business knowledge to delivery and support teams
· Support Delivery Owner in prioritisation
· Support Developers / Testers / Analysts in delivery and support business stakeholders in UAT

Key Accountabilities:

· Support process of Business context and Requirements gathering
· Undertake technical analysis; define and document business logic; mapping and governance and success criteria
· Attend and contribute to agile ceremonies – Iteration Planning/Stand-up meetings/Retrospectives/Showcases
· Facilitate elaborations sessions; attend and facilitate other workshops as necessary
· Support development and testing team in understanding of requirements
· Contribute to Knowledge Transfer as required during and after delivery of project
· Perform other duties as necessary during delivery of project and as assigned by Project/Iteration manager
· Work collaboratively maintaining ongoing dialogue and relationships with Stakeholders as part of continued solution development and support.

Internal Relationships

· Develop and maintain positive working relationships with business customers.
· Work collaboratively with solution design peers and other technical peers.
· Work collaboratively with other internal areas (other parts of IT) as required.

External Relationships

· Work with external partners/vendors as required

Key Qualifications: (indicate whether mandatory or desired)
· Tertiary qualifications in IT, Business or associated field (Desired)

Key Experience: (minimum type and level of experience required to perform the role)

· Minimum 2 years’ experience in a business/system analyst role (Mandatory)
· Project lifecycle experience (mandatory)
· Track record of working in a fast-paced collaborative cross-functional environment (desired)
· Proficiency in working with distributed teams (desired)

Key Capabilities/Technical Competencies (skills, knowledge, technical or specialist capabilities)

· Ability to analyse customer requirements and provide innovative solutions or alternatives to meet those requirements.
· Strong SQL, Data Analysis and Data Profiling skills
· Familiarity with Data Modelling and Data Warehouse concepts
· A disciplined approach to planning, implementation and project execution
· Excellent presentation and communication skills
· Sound change management skills
· Ability for both ‘technical speak’ and ‘business speak’ and able to translate one to another.
· Business acumen and industry knowledge with a strong understanding of business processes and products
· Knowledge of Business Process Modelling and associated tools.
· Knowledge of a variety of database platforms, e.g. Netezza, Oracle, DB2, etc
· Knowledge of applications support and development
· Ability to cope with pressure, prioritise workloads and meet agreed timeframes
· Good knowledge of Insurance domain (Desired)
· Experience with Cloud applications (Desired)

result.description:
Location: Melbourne  Salary: $180,000 to $250,000 package  Company:    With over 20 years of operations, this builder has developed themselves into a stalwart in the Tier 3 sector, specialising in Commercial, Education, Aged Care, Community buildings and much more! They build from $5m to $50m, across both Metro Melbourne and regional Victoria.  Having recently won a number of successful tenders across Victoria, this builder is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join their hardworking, high performing team to lead these projects.    The Job:    As the Project Manager, you will be required to manage multiple design & construct Commercial builds across Melbourne, ranging from $10m to $20m.  
  Key Responsibilities  
 
 
   Project Planning & Pre-Construction:   
 
 
  Define project scope, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders.  
 
 
  Develop and manage the master project schedule and budget.  
 
 
  Oversee the bidding process and manage contract negotiations with subcontractors and suppliers.  
 
 
  Secure necessary permits, resources, and materials for project commencement.  
 
 
 
 
   Project Execution:   
 
 
  Supervise daily on-site construction activities to ensure adherence to quality and safety standards.  
 
 
  Coordinate and manage all subcontractors and field personnel.  
 
 
  Proactively identify and resolve technical, operational, and site-specific issues to prevent delays.  
 
 
  Implement and enforce a comprehensive safety plan, conducting regular site inspections and safety meetings.  
 
 
 
 
   Financial & Administrative Management:   
 
 
  Continuously monitor project costs and expenditures against the approved budget.  
 
 
  Process and approve all project-related invoices and payments.  
 
 
  Document, price, and negotiate change orders with clients and subcontractors.  
 
 
  Maintain organised and accurate project documentation, including contracts, drawings, and daily logs.  
 
 
 
 
   Communication & Leadership:   
 
 
  Act as the primary point of contact for clients, architects, engineers, and other key stakeholders.  
 
 
  Provide clear and consistent leadership to the project team, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.  
 
 
  Prepare and present detailed progress reports to stakeholders, outlining project status, budget, and any potential risks.  
 
 
 
 
 Key Requirements:  
 
  Relevant construction related degree  
 
  Demonstrative experience as a Project manager in Commercial Construction in Australia.  
 
 
  Strong financial acumen and understanding of Australian building codes   
 
 A strong, hardworking attitude to the construction industry 
 
  A team player, who is willing to lead by example   
 
 
  Excellent administrative, communication, negotiation, and leadership abilities.  
 
 
 If you're interested in hearing more about this position, please reach out to Ryan on 0498510836 or ryan.attard@randstad.com.au

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background.
